unresolved_gaps: No located survey separately measures lawyers' use of generative AI to prepare briefs during the target period.
The located records do not establish how many brief-preparing lawyers appeared shocked by fabricated cases.
Incident counts cannot substitute for evidence of reactions, and repeated reports of one lawyer cannot establish 'many'.
The strongest located example of reported shock has a later qualification concerning the lawyer's honesty about authorship.
